title: Non-Disclosure Agreements
text:
A non-disclosure agreement is a legal contract that protects confidential information. Employees who sign it promise not to disclose business secrets to anyone outside the company. The agreement usually explains which information is covered and how long the duty of secrecy lasts.

If a person breaks this promise, the company may ask a court for an injunction or claim damages. Some agreements also include a penalty clause, which sets a fixed sum of money to be paid in case of a breach. Courts, however, may refuse to enforce a penalty that they consider unreasonably high.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do employees promise when they sign a non-disclosure agreement?
options: Not to disclose business secrets to outsiders
To leave the company after one year
To share their salary with colleagues

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what is a penalty clause?
options: A clause that sets a fixed sum to be paid after a breach
A clause that ends the contract immediately
A clause that increases the employee's salary
A clause that allows the employee to work abroad

questions.text: What can be inferred about a penalty that a court considers unreasonably high?
options: The court will always enforce it in full
The court may decide not to enforce it
The employee must pay it twice
The company loses the right to sue

questions.text: Why does the first paragraph mention how long the duty of secrecy lasts?
options: To show that secrecy is only temporary in every case
To suggest that the time limits matter as much as the content of the agreement
To prove that employees never sign such agreements
To explain how court fees are calculated

vocabulary.definition: meant to be kept secret and not shared with others
to make known information that was previously secret
a punishment, often a sum of money, for breaking a rule or agreement
a formal arrangement between two or more parties

paragraph_translations: Угода про нерозголошення — це юридичний договір, що захищає конфіденційну інформацію. Працівники, які її підписують, обіцяють не розголошувати комерційні таємниці нікому за межами компанії. Угода зазвичай пояснює, яка інформація охоплюється, і як довго діє обов'язок зберігати таємницю.

Якщо особа порушує цю обіцянку, компанія може звернутися до суду з вимогою заборони або відшкодування збитків. Деякі угоди також містять пункт про штраф, який встановлює фіксовану суму, що сплачується у разі порушення. Однак суди можуть відмовитися стягувати штраф, який вважають надмірно високим.
